Encompass Health is the nation’s largest system of rehabilitation hospitals. The trusted choice for patients, caregivers and medical professionals, we provide advanced therapy to help patients recovering from an illness or injury get back to what matters most. Our care teams, made up of thousands of dedicated professionals, are committed to achieving the best possible outcomes, serving our patients and communities through customized rehabilitation that exceeds expectations. 

Encompass Health is ranked as one of Fortune's 100 Best Companies to Work For and Modern Healthcare’s Best Places to Work in Healthcare. For more information, visit encompasshealth.com, or follow us on our newsroom, Twitter, Instagram and Facebook.
